var r = await machine.exec({ command: `cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, math
alld=json.load(open('/tmp/alld.json'))
W0,W1='2025-03-19','2025-04-16'
H0,H1='2025-01-02','2025-06-30'
names={'NVDA':'Nvidia','AAPL':'Apple','WMT':'Walmart','AMZN':'Amazon','META':'Meta'}
res={}
for t,rows in alld.items():
    w=[x for x in rows if W0<=x['date']<=W1]
    h=[x for x in rows if H0<=x['date']<=H1]
    assert len(w)==21, (t,len(w))
    opens=[x['open'] for x in w]
    wl=min(x['low'] for x in w); wh=max(x['high'] for x in w)
    fl=min(x['low'] for x in h); fh=max(x['high'] for x in h)
    n=len(opens); mu=sum(opens)/n
    std=math.sqrt(sum((o-mu)**2 for o in opens)/n)     # population
    vwap=sum(x['open']*x['volume'] for x in w)/sum(x['volume'] for x in w)
    cpc=(w[-1]['close']-w[0]['close'])/w[0]['close']*100
    adr=sum(x['high']-x['low'] for x in w)/n
    res[t]=dict(company=names[t], n_half=len(h), Window_Low=wl, Window_High=wh,
        FirstHalf_Low=fl, FirstHalf_High=fh, Low_Ratio=wl/fl, High_Ratio=wh/fh,
        Open_STD=std, VWAP_Open=vwap, Close_PctChange=cpc, Avg_Daily_Range=adr,
        opens=opens)
    # find dates of extremes for verification
    fld=[x['date'] for x in h if x['low']==fl][0]; fhd=[x['date'] for x in h if x['high']==fh][0]
    wld=[x['date'] for x in w if x['low']==wl][0]; whd=[x['date'] for x in w if x['high']==wh][0]
    print(t, 'halfN=',len(h), 'FH_Low',fl,fld,'FH_High',fh,fhd,'| W_Low',wl,wld,'W_High',wh,whd)
json.dump({k:{kk:vv for kk,vv in v.items()} for k,v in res.items()}, open('/tmp/res.json','w'))
print()
# dense rank on rounded High_Ratio, 1 = largest
hr={t: round(res[t]['High_Ratio'],2) for t in res}
uniq=sorted(set(hr.values()), reverse=True)
rank={v:i+1 for i,v in enumerate(uniq)}
print('%-8s %10s %10s %10s %10s %8s %8s %9s %10s %9s %9s %5s'%('Comp','WLow','WHigh','FHLow','FHHigh','LowR','HighR','OpenSTD','VWAP','ClosePct','AvgRange','Rk'))
order=['NVDA','AAPL','WMT','AMZN','META']
out={}
for t in order:
    v=res[t]
    row=dict(Window_Low=round(v['Window_Low'],2), Window_High=round(v['Window_High'],2),
        FirstHalf_Low=round(v['FirstHalf_Low'],2), FirstHalf_High=round(v['FirstHalf_High'],2),
        Low_Ratio=round(v['Low_Ratio'],2), High_Ratio=round(v['High_Ratio'],2),
        Open_STD=round(v['Open_STD'],2), VWAP_Open=round(v['VWAP_Open'],2),
        Close_PctChange=round(v['Close_PctChange'],2), Avg_Daily_Range=round(v['Avg_Daily_Range'],2),
        Rank_High_Ratio=rank[hr[t]])
    out[names[t]]=row
    print('%-8s %10.2f %10.2f %10.2f %10.2f %8.2f %8.2f %9.2f %10.2f %9.2f %9.2f %5d'%(names[t],
      row['Window_Low'],row['Window_High'],row['FirstHalf_Low'],row['FirstHalf_High'],row['Low_Ratio'],
      row['High_Ratio'],row['Open_STD'],row['VWAP_Open'],row['Close_PctChange'],row['Avg_Daily_Range'],row['Rank_High_Ratio']))
print()
print('raw High_Ratio:', {t: round(res[t]['High_Ratio'],6) for t in order})
json.dump(out, open('/tmp/summary_out.json','w'), indent=1)
json.dump({names[t]: [round(o,2) for o in res[t]['opens']] for t in order}, open('/tmp/daily_out.json','w'), indent=1)
EOF` })
